name: alert
description: Inspect, wait for, accept, or dismiss a platform alert. Use get before acting when the alert content matters; accept and dismiss change the active alert state.

name: app-switcher
description: Open the device app switcher to inspect or change foreground apps. This changes the visible system UI and may move focus away from the current app.

name: apps
description: List the apps installed on the selected device. Include system or OEM apps only when they are needed as automation targets.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

appsFilter.description: Restrict the listing to user-installed apps, or include system and OEM apps.

name: appstate
description: Show foreground app/activity

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

name: back
description: Navigate back in the app or through system navigation. Use in-app for the app navigation stack and system when the platform back behavior is required.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

name: batch
description: Execute multiple commands in one daemon request

steps.description: Structured batch steps. Each step uses a command name and the same input object as that command tool.

command.description: Command name to run with structured input.

input.description: Structured command input for the nested command. Use the matching MCP tool schema for this object.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of steps accepted for this batch.

out.description: Optional output path for command artifacts.

name: boot
description: Boot or prepare the selected device or simulator so later commands can target it. The device is chosen through the device-selection inputs, not by naming it here.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

headless.description: Boot without showing simulator UI when supported.

name: capabilities
description: List the commands supported by the selected device or active session. Use device-selection inputs when checking support before a session is open.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

name: click
description: Activate a UI target by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates. Prefer a ref or selector after a snapshot; use coordinates only when semantic targeting is unavailable. This can change app state; use settle or verify to confirm the result without a follow-up snapshot.

label.description: Optional human label for the ref.

target.description: UI element ref, selector, or screen point.

button.description: Pointer button for platforms that support mouse buttons.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

verify.description: Capture cheap post-action evidence (AX digest, node counts, changedFromBefore) instead of a follow-up snapshot.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

name: clipboard
description: Read the current device clipboard text, or replace its contents with the given text.

name: close
description: Close the named app, or close the active session app when app is omitted. Use shutdown only when the selected simulator or emulator should also stop.

name: debug
description: Symbolicate Apple crash artifacts with matching dSYM UUIDs. This debug namespace is intentionally narrow: use logs for app logs, network for HTTP evidence, perf for performance samples, record/trace for media and traces, and react-devtools for React Native profiles.

searchPath.description: Directory to scan for matching .dSYM bundles.

out.description: Output path for the symbolicated artifact.

name: devices
description: List available devices and simulators that can be selected for automation. Use platform, device, udid, or serial inputs on later commands to target one result.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

name: diff
description: Compare accessibility snapshots or screenshots to identify UI changes. Use snapshot comparisons for semantic tree changes and screenshot comparisons for pixel differences.

name: doctor
description: Diagnose device, app, development-server, and React Native or Expo readiness issues. Returns compact evidence for local inventory, sessions, optional app discovery, toolchains, and server reachability. On iOS simulators it also warms the XCTest runner build cache in the background when missing, so run it before the first Apple snapshot or interaction of a session.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

targetApp.description: Installed app package/bundle id or app name to verify without opening a session.

remote.description: Check remote connection setup instead of local device inventory.

name: events
description: Read the daemon-owned session event timeline as paged JSON-friendly entries

name: fill
description: Replace text in a UI input selected by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates. Prefer refs or selectors after snapshot; use recordAs to keep sensitive text out of a recorded replay while sending it to the live app.

label.description: Optional human label for the ref.

target.description: UI element ref, selector, or screen point.

text.description: Text to enter into the target.

recordAs.description: When script recording is armed, send text to the live app but publish it as ${VAR}. Use an uppercase replay variable name such as PASSWORD.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

verify.description: Capture cheap post-action evidence (AX digest, node counts, changedFromBefore) instead of a follow-up snapshot.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

name: find
description: Find by text/label/value/role/id and run action

record.description: Force-record this out-of-band observation into a repair-armed heal (mutually exclusive with noRecord). Authored replay steps are recorded automatically and never need this. On find, valid only for a read-only action.

name: focus
description: Move input focus to explicit screen coordinates without entering text. Prefer semantic interactions when a snapshot ref or selector is available; use type or fill after focus.

name: gesture
description: Perform a structured pan, fling, swipe, pinch, rotate, transform, or drag gesture. Select the gesture kind, then provide only the inputs that apply to that kind.

delta.description: Movement delta for pan or transform gestures.

destinationHoldMs.description: Hold before releasing at the destination.

name: get
description: Read text or accessibility attributes from a snapshot ref or selector without changing the app. Use format text for visible content or attrs for the element attribute map.

label.description: Optional human label for the ref.

target.description: UI element ref, selector, or screen point.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

record.description: Force-record this out-of-band observation into a repair-armed heal (mutually exclusive with noRecord). Authored replay steps are recorded automatically and never need this. On find, valid only for a read-only action.

name: home
description: Send the selected device to its home screen. This leaves the app session open but moves the foreground away from the app.

name: install
description: Install an app binary from a local path. Provide an app identifier with the path when the target needs explicit app selection; use reinstall to replace an already installed app.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

name: is
description: Check whether a selector satisfies a UI predicate such as visible, hidden, editable, selected, focused, or text. Use wait when the condition may appear asynchronously.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

record.description: Force-record this out-of-band observation into a repair-armed heal (mutually exclusive with noRecord). Authored replay steps are recorded automatically and never need this. On find, valid only for a read-only action.

name: keyboard
description: Inspect Android keyboard visibility/type or press/dismiss the device keyboard. To hide the keyboard, use keyboard dismiss. It taps the keyboard dismiss/hide key when one is exposed, verifies the keyboard closed, and reports UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION when no dismiss key exists — background taps are never attempted.

name: longpress
description: Hold a UI target by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates to open a context menu or perform another hold gesture. Set durationMs when the default hold duration is unsuitable.

label.description: Optional human label for the ref.

target.description: UI element ref, selector, or screen point.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

name: metro
description: Prepare a React Native development server or ask connected apps to reload, using the development server this session is bound to. Provide explicit runtime inputs only to override that binding for one call. The binding is cleared when the session closes, and a fresh open without runtime hints also clears any leftover binding from a previous same-name session.

name: network
description: Dump recent HTTP(s) traffic parsed from the session app log

name: open
description: Boot the selected device when needed, then open an app, deep link, or URL in a session. Use the app or URL inputs to choose what becomes the foreground automation target. Metro and debug runtime hints given here are recorded as the session's dev-server binding, so a later reload reuses them; a fresh open without them clears any binding left by a previous same-name session.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

app.description: App name, bundle id, package, or URL.

url.description: Optional URL passed with an app shell.

surface.description: macOS presentation surface to open: the app itself, the frontmost app, the desktop, or the menu bar.

launchArgs.description: Launch arguments forwarded verbatim to the platform launch command.

foreground.description: Include an initial interactive snapshot in a fresh open response. With no app argument, discover the sole running app on the sole booted iOS simulator; ambiguous environments fail closed.

deviceHub.description: Use Xcode Device Hub when surfacing Apple simulators.

testIme.description: Activate the headless Android test IME for deterministic Unicode text entry (default on for emulators; opt-in on real devices).

metroHost.description: Session-scoped Metro/debug host hint applied to the opened app.

metroPort.description: Session-scoped Metro/debug port hint applied to the opened app. On an emulator/simulator the host defaults to the loopback alias (Android 10.0.2.2, iOS 127.0.0.1) when --metro-host is omitted; physical devices still require an explicit --metro-host.

bundleUrl.description: Session-scoped bundle URL hint applied to the opened app.

launchUrl.description: Session-scoped launch URL hint applied to the opened app.

name: orientation
description: Set device orientation on iOS and Android

name: press
description: Short-press a UI target by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates. Use longpress instead when the target requires a context-menu or hold gesture.

label.description: Optional human label for the ref.

target.description: UI element ref, selector, or screen point.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

verify.description: Capture cheap post-action evidence (AX digest, node counts, changedFromBefore) instead of a follow-up snapshot.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

name: push
description: Deliver push notification payloads to an installed app.

name: react-native
description: Run supported React Native automation helpers. Use dismiss-overlay to close a visible development error overlay before continuing normal UI automation.

name: record
description: Start or stop a screen recording for the active app session or, where supported, the selected device. Long Android recordings can return multiple video artifacts; HarmonyOS supports whole-screen recording on physical devices.

name: reinstall
description: Replace an installed app with a binary from a local path. Use this when preserving the same app identity while installing a new build on the selected device.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

name: replay
description: Run a recorded automation script, including compatible Maestro YAML flows. A script without a terminal close leaves its session active for subsequent automation.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

metroHost.description: Metro/debug host hint inherited by replay-opened sessions.

metroPort.description: Metro/debug port hint inherited by replay-opened sessions.

bundleUrl.description: Bundle URL hint inherited by replay-opened sessions.

keepSession.description: Leave the session active by suppressing exactly an authored terminal close in native .ad.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wall-clock duration for the replay request.

name: screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the active app or web session. Choose the capture scope, density, size, or annotations through the corresponding input fields when needed.

pixelDensity.description: Output screenshot pixel density in pixels per logical point.

name: scroll
description: Scroll in a direction, or toward the top/bottom edge of scrollable content.

durationMs.description: Scroll duration in milliseconds when the backend supports pacing.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

name: session
description: List active sessions, print the effective daemon state directory, or publish an armed open-to-destination script without closing its session

action.description: list shows active sessions; state-dir prints the daemon state directory; save-script publishes an armed recording without teardown.

force.description: Atomically replace an existing save-script target.

name: settings
description: Change supported operating-system settings, animation scales, appearance, or app permissions on the selected target. Platform support varies by setting and action.

name: shutdown
description: Shutdown a selected simulator or emulator.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

name: snapshot
description: Capture the accessibility tree or compare it with the previous session baseline. Use the returned refs for subsequent semantic interactions and the diff option to verify UI changes.

customActions.description: Name the affordances an element merged away (iOS UIAccessibilityCustomAction, React Native accessibilityActions) — a card whose reply/options controls are not separate elements still lists them here. The names are for PLANNING, not invocation: there is no API to trigger them, so reach the affordance through the element detail screen, through the same control exposed as a labeled element elsewhere, or by coordinates from its rect. iOS simulator only; costs one accessibility round trip per merged element.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wall-clock time for the snapshot command.

record.description: Force-record this out-of-band observation into a repair-armed heal (mutually exclusive with noRecord). Authored replay steps are recorded automatically and never need this.

name: swipe
description: Quick coordinate fling with optional repeat pattern.

name: test
description: Run one or more replay scripts as a serial test suite

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

metroHost.description: Metro/debug host hint inherited by each test session.

metroPort.description: Metro/debug port hint inherited by each test session.

bundleUrl.description: Bundle URL hint inherited by each test session.

name: trace
description: Start or stop trace-log capture and return the resulting artifact when capture ends. Use the same artifact path for the matching start and stop requests when an explicit path is required.

name: trigger-app-event
description: Ask the app to handle an app-defined automation or test event, with an optional structured payload. Call this only for event names and payload shapes the app documents.

event.description: Name of an app-defined automation or test event the app documents.

payload.description: Structured payload passed to the event, in the shape the app documents for it.

name: type
description: Append text to the currently focused input. Use fill when the existing field value should be replaced, and focus first when no input is active.

name: wait
description: Wait for a duration, text, snapshot ref, selector, or stable UI. Use text, ref, or selector for a specific readiness condition; stable waits until the UI stays quiet for the requested window.
